title: Cango Inc. to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 30, 2026, Eastern Time
summary: Cango Inc. (NYSE: CANG) today announced that it plans to release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, November 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
Dallas, Texas, November 25, 2026 - Cango Inc. (NYSE: CANG) ("Cango" or the "Company"), a Bitcoin miner leveraging its global operations to develop an integrated energy and AI compute platform, today announced that it plans to release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, November 30, 2026. The earnings release will be available on the Company's investor relations website at[http://ir.cangoonline.com](http://ir.cangoonline.com/) .


Cango's management will hold a conference call on Monday, November 30, 2026, at 9:00 P.M. Eastern Time or Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. Hong Kong Time to discuss the financial results. Listeners may access the call by dialing the following numbers:


International: +1-412-902-4272


United States Toll Free: +1-888-346-8982


Canada Toll Free: +1-855-669-9657


Mainland China Toll: +86-4008-424327


Hong Kong Toll: +852-2515-0150


Conference ID: Cango Inc.


The replay will be accessible through December 6, 2026, by dialing the following numbers:


International: + 1-412-317-0088


United States Toll Free: + 1-855-669-9658


Access Code: 8121247


A live and archived webcast of the conference call will also be available at the Company's investor relations website at[http://ir.cangoonline.com](http://ir.cangoonline.com/) .


About Cango Inc.


Cango Inc. (NYSE: CANG) is a Bitcoin mining company with a vision to establish an integrated, global infrastructure platform capable of powering the future digital economy. The Company's mining operations span across North America, the Middle East, South America, and East Africa.


Since entering the digital asset space in November 2024, Cango has activated pilot projects in both integrated energy solutions and distributed AI computing.


For more information, please visit:[www.cangoonline.com](https://www.cangoonline.com/) and follow us on:[X](https://x.com/Cango_Group) .
